name: Range hood
scene: A hood on the wall above a cooktop (show the cooktop counter below at 0.9 m and the wall cabinets or chimney above), with grease filters underneath, the fan behind them, the light, the control buttons on the front lip, and the duct going up.
size: 0.76-0.91 m wide, 0.12-0.2 m tall (under-cabinet) or a chimney up to the ceiling, 0.45-0.5 m deep; bottom at about 1.6 m.

parts.label: Hood
parts.describe: Stainless or painted canopy, hollow underneath.

parts.label: Grease filter
parts.describe: Aluminium mesh or stainless baffle filter under the hood; tips down from the back latch and comes out. Usually two side by side (use two parts or repeat on a static copy).

parts.label: Grease
parts.describe: Brown grease film on the filter (patch of oil or grime, child of the filter).

parts.label: Fan
parts.describe: Blower wheel in its housing above the filters.

parts.label: Light
parts.describe: Bulb or LED under the front edge behind a lens that twists or pops out.

parts.label: Fan button
parts.describe: Button or slider on the front lip.

parts.label: Light button
parts.describe: Button next to the fan button.

parts.label: Duct
parts.describe: Round or rectangular duct going up from the top of the hood (foil or galvanised).

views: from below and in front for the filters and light
notes: The hood sits high: keep the cooktop below as context. The underside must be open so the filters show.
